column1: # Static intrusive-list teardowns - EC-7 family C
# 224 members, all 82 bytes. Byte images 186; FORM images 1.
# Shape: unlink a node from an intrusive doubly-linked list ([rcx+8]=rax ; [rax]=rcx),

#          operator delete (test rcx,rcx / jne 0019C570 / ret -> the _aligned_free stub).
# NOT dispositioned: 00584730, still in the frontier.
